fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 1965 Pontiac LeMans convertible.
findings: Green paint is glossy overall but shows a slightly flat, uneven sheen on the trunk lid and rear quarters
Light dust and grime in the engine bay, on the inner fenders and around the air cleaner and valve cover
Tonneau/boot cover area behind the rear seat looks dusty and wrinkled
Front and rear chrome bumpers show some dullness and haze
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1965 LeMans convertible, it's a great looking cruiser. The green paint has good gloss, and a light buff on the trunk lid and rear quarters plus an engine bay cleanup would make it pop even more in photos. We do pre-sale details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
